description: EXACT: a₀(A) = 2 × 8^A for all atoms A=2..6. The leading Habiro coefficient is 2 × (Vol(B₃)/G)^A. The factor 2 = dim(V_{(2,1)}) from the confinement SDP interface. The factor 8^A = (proton octahedra count)^A. This connects the categorical Δ_λ (sign × dim) to the Habiro ring integer structure via the confinement constraint.

structural_decomposition.8: Vol(B₃)/G = number of ideal octahedra in Borromean complement
structural_decomposition.2: dim(V_{(2,1)}) = standard rep dimension = confinement interface block
structural_decomposition.8^A: each of A nucleons contributes 8 octahedra

data.provable_via: confinement SDP + Burnside (Frobenius-PSD forces regular-rep weights)
